description: Task runner for the POS repo. Not an npm workspace on purpose: mobile/ (Expo, React 19.2) and web/ (Vite, React 19.3) keep separate installs so neither bundler sees two Reacts; both link packages/pos-core with a file: dependency.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix mobile install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.check:mobile: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint && npm --prefix mobile test -- --silent
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run check:mobile && npm run check:web
